answer: Bonded settlement ladder: each identity locks 1,000 POA to answer, released in four 250 tranches only as its own answers settle passing across later epochs — an oasis of earned standing no fresh clone can buy. The bond is per key, so 1,000 clones lock 1,000,000 POA, and each tranche needs that identity's own settled pass, a beacon no echo of another's history can fake. A failed answer forfeits its tranche; peers verify the settlement record on-ledger before any release.
